tool: curl from the Arena agent sandbox workspace (thru-wallet-ext)
finding: Direct egress from the build sandbox to thru.org infrastructure fails at the TLS handshake: curl exit 35 (OpenSSL SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL), HTTP 000, for rpc.betanet.thru.org, scan.thru.org and thru.org alike. Egress to github.com (git/gh) works, and the agent's page-fetch tool reaches thru.org through a separate path. CONSEQUENCE: no live-chain Gate 0 evidence can be produced from this sandbox. The repo anticipated this case (docs/MANUAL_SMOKE_CHECKLIST.md: a sandboxed environment fails every call with 'fetch failed'). Live dossier rows must be produced on a network-reachable machine with scripts/verify-*.mjs, scripts/probe-*.mjs and scripts/token-lab.mjs using throwaway accounts.
